subject: s0688
centreline_method: per-axial-slice centre of mass of the esophagus label, ordered cranial->caudal, cubic smoothing spline with s = n*(0.5 voxel)^2 (a half-voxel centroid jitter budget), resampled at 1 mm. Length is stable to +-2 mm across a 64x range of smoothing factors (305-309 mm).
radius_method: Euclidean distance transform of the label (anisotropy-aware), sampled at each centreline point by trilinear interpolation = maximum inscribed sphere radius. This is the LUMEN+WALL inner-to-label radius, not the mucosal lumen radius; the oesophagus is collapsed in a resting CT and the label follows the outer wall.
